stem_md: 设 $f(u,v)$ 为二元可微函数，$z=f(x^y,y^x)$，求 $z_x$。

options_json.content_md: $\ln x\cdot x^y f_1'+\ln y\cdot y^x f_2'$

analysis_md: 由 $z=f(x^y,y^x)$ 知 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=yx^{y-1}f_1'+\ln y\cdot y^xf_2'$
search_text: 设 $f(u,v)$ 为二元可微函数，$z=f(x^y,y^x)$，求 $z_x$。 $yx^y f_1'-\ln y\cdot y^x f_2'$ $yx^{y-1}f_1'+xy^{x-1}f_2'$ $yx^{y-1}f_1'+\ln y\cdot y^x f_2'$ $\ln x\cdot x^y f_1'+\ln y\cdot y^x f_2'$ 由 $z=f(x^y,y^x)$ 知 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=yx^{y-1}f_1'+\ln y\cdot y^xf_2'$
